label_title_scan_pending: Process pending/new items in this folder
label_title_reanalyze: Force re-analyze ALL items in this folder
label_subtitle: Manage scan folders and re-analyze in bulk
mode_pending_body: Scans folders for new or updated files and processes only un-analyzed or failed items. Completed items are skipped.
mode_reanalyze_body: Re-evaluates every item, including completed ones, with the current vision model and the high-resolution prompt.
confirm_reanalyze_body: Existing tags on every media item are cleared before the analysis runs again.
